documents.unit: Office of Academic Affairs & Provost (AI at Tulane site)
documents.title: Artificial Intelligence at Tulane University: Guidelines for the Ethical and Responsible Use of AI
documents.quality_note: Guidelines on transparency, data protection, tool review and instructor-set course rules; points to academic integrity policies for student use.

documents.title: AI Research (Tulane student guidance on AI use)
documents.quality_note: Library guide restating Tulane's student rules: unauthorized assistance including generative AI violates the Code of Academic Conduct; students own and verify AI content. Secondary source for the Provost's letter, which could not be found directly.

notes: The Provost's letter to faculty (reported by the Tulane Hullabaloo) is the likely primary source for the default prohibition but was not located online. provost.tulane.edu/node/368608 (Faculty Guide to Using Generative AI) returned only an introduction and navigation, so it was not collected. it.tulane.edu/node/136 returned nothing. No School of Science and Engineering or CS-unit policy found.
